tier1.text: Each semimembranosus flexes, or bends, the knee. It also helps extend, or straighten, the hip. It is one of the three hamstring muscles, which run down the back of the thigh. It starts on the ischial tuberosity, the part of the hip bone we sit on.

sentences.text: Each semimembranosus flexes, or bends, the knee.

quotes.quote: The posterior compartment of the thigh includes the hamstrings: the biceps femoris, semitendinosus, and the semimembranosus, which all flex the knee.
quotes.section: 11.6 Appendicular Muscles of the Pelvic Girdle and Lower Limbs
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: flexion: movement in the sagittal plane that decreases the angle of a joint (bends the joint)
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: It also helps extend, or straighten, the hip.

quotes.quote: functions, in conjunction with the other muscles of the hamstring group, to extend the leg at the hip and to flex the leg at the knee
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: extension: movement in the sagittal plane that increases the angle of a joint (straightens the joint)
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: It is one of the three hamstring muscles, which run down the back of the thigh.

quotes.quote: One of the three muscles that compose the hamstring muscles (semitendinosus, semimembranosus, bicepsfemoris); it is located in the posterior compartment of the thigh
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: A group of muscles including the biceps femoris, semimembranosus and semitendinosus that extend down the back of the thigh.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

sentences.text: It starts on the ischial tuberosity, the part of the hip bone we sit on.

quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: ischial tuberosity: large, roughened protuberance that forms the posteroinferior portion of the hip bone; weight-bearing region of the pelvis when sitting
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
